sloka: स ष्ट्चाअष्टौ च वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने ।आसेवमानो वन्यानि फलमूलैश्च चर्तयन् ॥२-२०-३१॥
transliteration: sa ṣṭcāaṣṭau ca varṣāṇi vatsyāmi vijane vane ।āsevamāno vanyāni phalamūlaiśca cartayan ॥2-20-31॥

translations.english: Living on things available in the forest, on fruits and roots, I am to dwell in the uninhabited jungle for fourteen years.
